/**
   * Stores custom keywords (tags) for a list of messages on the IMAP server.
   *
   * @note Keyword Sanitization & Restrictions
   * To prevent server parse errors and local state desynchronization, the
   * keywords provided in flagsToAdd and flagsToSubtract are strictly sanitized.
   * Any keyword containing invalid characters is silently dropped from the
   * network request.
   *
   * A keyword is deemed invalid if it contains any of the following:
   * 1. Non-ASCII characters (>= 0x7F) or control characters / spaces (<= 0x20).
   * 2. RFC 3501 wildcards and quoted-specials: % * " \
   * 3. Symmetrical Enclosures: ( ) [ ] { }
   * Note: While '[' and '}' are technically valid atom-chars under RFC 3501,
   * they are strictly filtered here to prevent UX confusion and to defend
   * against poorly written IMAP server parsers that trip on unescaped brackets.
   * 4. Internal URI Delimiters: < > ;
   * Restricted because Thunderbird uses nsIURI to route IMAP commands internally.
   * '<' and '>' are Unsafe URI characters (RFC 3986), and '>' specifically
   * breaks Thunderbird's hardcoded IMAP URL parser. The ';' is restricted as it
   * is the reserved delimiter for internal URL parameters (e.g., ;SECTION=TEXT).
   *
   * Ampersands are allowed because they are valid IMAP atom characters and
   * occur in legacy tag keys encoded as modified UTF-7.
   *
   * @param aMailFolder            The IMAP folder containing the messages.
   * @param aMsgWindow             The message window for status/error reporting.
   * @param flagsToAdd             Space-separated string of keywords to add.
   * @param flagsToSubtract        Space-separated string of keywords to remove.
   * @param aMessageIdentifierList Comma-separated list of message UIDs.
   *
   * @return nsIURI                The internal IMAP URL generated for this command.
   */
  nsIURI storeCustomKeywords(in nsIMsgFolder aMailFolder,
                             in nsIMsgWindow aMsgWindow,
                             in ACString flagsToAdd,
                             in ACString flagsToSubtract,
                             in ACString aMessageIdentifierList);
